title: Mussels Marinara

difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg mussels
- 20 g parsley
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
- 1 lemon
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Wash the mussels under running water, scraping the shells with a small knife and removing the beard.
2. Place them in a saucepan with the peeled garlic and oil; cover with a lid and let them open over low heat.
3. Wash the parsley, remove the stems and chop it coarsely.
4. Arrange the mussels in a salad bowl, filter their liquid and pour it over the preparation, removing the garlic.
5. Sprinkle with parsley, a grind of pepper and finish with the lemon cut into large slices.
6. Anchovy croutons
